We need to actually call get_template with some ID, but we don't know ID. Could we list available templates? No tool.

Maybe we can search template catalog by criteria with a more complex target: use the target aldehyde SMILES we constructed. Then we can get list of templates that match. Let's construct target SMILES as described: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO". Use that as molecule_smiles. Search with functional_groups_broken=["carboxylic esters"]? But target no longer has ester. Instead broken group is "carboxylic esters" in forward direction, so in retrosynthesis we are forming ester (broken in forward). So functional_groups_formed in forward = aldehyde, broken = ester. For retrosynthesis, we want templates that break aldehyde to ester? The criteria refer to forward reaction. So we should specify functional_groups_broken=["carboxylic esters"] (since forward breaks ester) and functional_groups_formed=["aldehydes"] (since forward forms aldehyde). That we tried with simple ester and got empty. Maybe need more specific target (the aldehyde). Let's try with our target aldehyde SMILES and same criteria.
